input_domain: 146 directed + 10000 deterministic randomized SpiderScan cases; laser called in 1725 observed original/candidate runs; positive case is matching-target-kill-dir0-life01.
compared_effects: laser request arguments and ordered helper/callback trace
SpiderScan return and simulation globals/LifeA/ant arrays/map/RNG/non-stack writes
limitations: Rendering and sound device output is not reproduced. This cert only treats the laser request coordinate tuple and event order as intent; render dirt, VGA/window writes and sound backend state are outside SpiderScan simulation contract.
source_contract: DoLaserFire source starts myBeginSound(0x37,0x8265,0x3f), then computes/clips/draws laser geometry and marks render dirt. myBeginSound is driver-gated and delegates to f_295C_0367, whose callees dispatch audio state/backends; inspected audio sources mutate audio channel/sample/register state, with no RNG, LifeA, ant-list or simulation-state references. The SpiderScan boundary records exact DoLaserFire args; the coordinate mutant changes x and is observed in trace only.

review.reason: Reviewed exact helper source and caller data flow. This certificate compares logical UI/audio/timing requests at a simulation boundary; actual simulation/map/RNG helpers execute in the original oracle, and caller-source mutants expose changed boundary requests.
